scope: Existing native-clone setup, two shared transaction helpers, optional typed native actor injection into the existing authority testkit and the three specifically approved native consumers. No new release gate or production auth/kernel changes.
repairs: Each test clone gets independent random runtime/SYSTEM/ordinary-auth/auth-system LOGIN credentials, NOINHERIT/NOSUPERUSER/NOBYPASSRLS/NOCREATEDB/NOCREATEROLE, with source-compiled PostgreSQL15/16 membership options. Both incoming and outgoing role edges plus actual attributes are validated before publishing URLs.

All action/auth URLs point at the exact clone. Explicit operator URL remains available only for seed/catalog setup. Canonical mode1 is installed centrally, pools close, owned clone/roles drop, and prior environment values restore. No template-auth or operator-action fallback exists.

The session factory calls production createSession under its scoped identity executor, holds the real opaque bearer only in closures and runs production withBearerOrgBinding. It never seeds a user/membership, invents a role/relationship, writes a derived grant, issues deterministic cookies or remints a revoked cached parent.

Native runtime/SYSTEM transactions use their own restricted connections with SET LOCAL ROLE. Positive runtime work carries a live request-scoped bridge through the production context SQL. Missing actor/org remains an explicit unauthenticated negative SQL probe.

Shared route authorization reads actual live canonical membership rather than an in-memory declared role. Existing transactional/savepoint and committed-versus-rolled-back audit behavior remains. Binding errors use the existing production sanitizer so failed driver parameters cannot expose bridge credentials.

The combined kernel fixture uses bounded activeMembershipSource, an injected bearer-bound ceremony runner, default-denied identity bindings, preserved case/document/forged-actor/audit checks, and denial-focused finance probes. Thread assignment and deadline dashboard fixtures now carry real canonical actor/session context. Operator seed data is committed before a separate auth connection reads it.

localTests.scope: Clone lifecycle/socket operations doubled; actual source-compiled PGlite roles/RLS and real production auth context/session/bearer services execute via a socket transport adapter. This is not native server/login or clone execution.

testedCounterexamples: Provisional clone/role provisioning failure cleans owned resources; disposal errors propagate.
Actual role graph rejects unexpected incoming membership and extra outgoing auth-system access.
GUC-only actor/org has zero visible business rows, while a real source-issued parent/bridge returns only owned rows.
Revoked parent stays revoked in cache; inactive user or non-member cannot issue a bound parent.
Already issued sessions re-read user/membership revocation before callback execution.
Existing testkit runs through the injected real session boundary.
Raw bridge values are absent from both raw-driver and Drizzle binding-failure errors.

financialBoundary.readinessMeaning: financeSourceReadiness is retained only as an engineering/schema fact; broad historical manifest DML is not accepted as proof that a member has financial authority.
financialBoundary.strictNativeProbeAdded: Own-organization INSERT and UPDATE by live role=member; emits actual actor, runtime/login role, live-session validity boolean, current physical RLS policies, affected rows, persisted outcomes and exact test-source hash. Any successful mutation fails the test and is an adverse counterexample. No bearer/credential is emitted.
